文件存在，现在调用一次 `jury_run`（tier=standard）。

result:
评审结果：2 项（consensus 1 / disputed 0 / solo 1；Important 2 / Nit 0 / Pre-existing 0；已过滤 0）
评审档位：standard（用户显式覆盖；风险评分 6；命中信号：变更 60 行 (+1)、涉及 4 个文件 (+1)、新增或修改网络/数据库/支付外部调用 (+3)、修改测试断言或启用状态 (+1)）

1. [consensus] [Important] compare() compares Dnum tuples as strings, not values
   证据：src/operations.ts:79 `  return num1_ > num2_ ? 1 : num1_ < num2_ ? -1 : 0;`
   normalizePairAndDecimals returns [bigint, decimals] tuples, so `num1_ > num2_` stringifies them ("10,0" < "9,0"): compare(10n, 9n) wrongly returns -1. Compare num1_[0] with num2_[0].
   发现者：correctness, security, design, test-integrity；voter：valid — voter1: Tuples stringify (">" on [10n,0] vs [9n,0] compares "10,0" < "9,0"), yielding -1; equal() correctly uses [0].

2. [solo] [Important] compare() tests miss magnitude cases that expose the bug
   证据：test/all.test.ts:296 `        [70000n, 4] as const,`
   Sort inputs (1, 8n, [70000n,4], 3.1, 2n, 5) all align to equal-length strings, so the tuple-string bug passes. Add compare(10n, 9n) or the 0.000016 vs 0.0013 case.
   发现者：test-integrity；voter：valid — voter1: Sort cases equalize to equal-length digit strings, so the tuple-string comparator happens to pass; no magnitude case catches it.
